first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests onboarding improvements can lift time-to-value and early adoption. Verification should confirm the durability and scope of those effects before committing. A guarded test will monitor qualified activation and downstream revenue quality, not just completion rate, to avoid trading lead quality for faster onboarding.

final.rationale: Run a standard randomized onboarding simplification experiment, prioritizing the simultaneous 4% onboarding decline and 6% activation decline. The verified evidence shows shortened onboarding improves completion, reduces time-to-value, and produces the strongest observed retention lift (+3% at 30 days), making it the better path to sustainable qualified revenue than optimizing activation messaging alone. Monitor qualified activation, 30-day retention, expansion or paid conversion, and lead quality—not just completion—to ensure faster onboarding does not reduce downstream value.
